lines.en: : Hmm...am I in the right place? There don’t be appear to be any customers.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我是不是走错地方了?这里似乎没有任何客人。

lines.en: : Mmph!!?! Wrclsd!!!
lines.zh: : 唔唔!!?!咯嘶咯嘶!!!

lines.en: : Be quiet. We haven’t been caught-
lines.zh: : 安静。我们还没被抓到——

lines.en: : Oh, Akira. What are you doing here?
lines.zh: : 哦,Akira。你来这里做什么?

lines.en: : Aghkrrra?! Isstyrnmm?!
lines.zh: : 咳嘶噜?!是你吗哦天?!

lines.en: : I work here now.
lines.zh: : 我现在在这里工作了。

lines.en: : Oh, is that so? I’d assumed your leave from teaching at Kumon-mi High would only be temporary, but perhaps I was wrong if you’ve already sought new employment.
lines.zh: : 哦,是吗?我还以为你从 Kumon-mi 高中停职只是暂时的,可你都另谋新职了,那也许是我看错了。

lines.en: : Yup. I’ve always wanted to be a bartender.
lines.zh: : 对。我一直想当酒保。

lines.en: : Who is that?! Is that the rich lady?! What’s she doing here?! What do I do?!
lines.zh: : 那是谁?!是那位有钱太太?!她来干什么?!我该怎么办?!

lines.en: : Stop asking questions you already know the answer to.
lines.zh: : 别问你已经知道答案的问题。

lines.en: : I figured out the first answer on my own! It’s the second one I’m struggling with!
lines.zh: : 第一个答案我自己想出来了!我卡住的是第二个!

lines.en: : I don’t care what you do, just stop making noise.
lines.zh: : 你做什么我不管,别再出声就行。

lines.en: : Are you...talking to yourself?
lines.zh: : 你……在自言自语?

lines.en: : Life has been hard. I’m experiencing daily mental lapses due to recent traumatic events. Some of which involve talking to myself.
lines.zh: : 日子艰难。由于最近的创伤事件,我每天都会出现精神断片。其中一部分就是自言自语。

lines.en: : Oh dear. Perhaps you should see a doctor, then? I wouldn’t mind referring you to my family’s psychologist. I actually have a meeting with her and that Yasu girl next week.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。那也许该去看看医生?我不介意把你推荐给我们家的心理医生。下周我正要和她还有那个 Yasu 女孩见面。

lines.en: : If you’re okay with it, I could put in a good word for-
lines.zh: : 你不介意的话,我可以替你美言——

lines.en: : Nope. I have a therapist already.
lines.zh: : 不必。我已经有心理医生了。

lines.en: : You do? Who is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗?是谁?

lines.en: : I believe that’s confidential, Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 我想那属于保密事项,Tsubasa。

lines.en: : I was under the impression that was merely on the doctor’s behalf?
lines.zh: : 我印象里,保密只是医生那边的义务?

lines.en: : Normally, yes. But mine is-
lines.zh: : 通常如此。但我的那位——

lines.en: : Ahmf~
lines.zh: : 唔姆~

lines.en: : ...Great at his job. And not accepting new patients at the moment.
lines.zh: : ……技术非常出色。而且目前不收新病人。

lines.en: Sara, instead of remaining still, goes back to sucking me off because of course she does.
lines.zh: Sara 没有安分下来,反而继续给我口——她当然会这样。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I oppose it. I had a feeling this was going to happen the moment I told her to stop making noise instead of keeping her mouth shut. But hey, challenge is my middle name.
lines.zh: 这倒不是说我反对。从我叫她「别出声」而不是「闭嘴」的那一刻起,我就预感到了。但嘿,挑战就是我的中间名。

lines.en: : Are you sure it’s just a mental issue? Because, I’m no medical professional, but you appear to be showing signs of physical distress as well.
lines.zh: : 你确定只是精神问题?因为我不是医疗专业人士,但你看起来也呈现出一些生理痛苦的迹象。

lines.en: : Inner battle. Hard to fight. What can I get you?
lines.zh: : 内心交战。很难打。您要点什么?

lines.en: : Just a glass of wine, please.
lines.zh: : 请给我一杯红酒就好。

lines.en: : Ahn...ahm...mlm...
lines.zh: : 啊嗯……啊姆……姆姆……

lines.en: : Is there...a step I’m missing when it comes to ordering? I don’t typically patronize establishments such as this and am used to simply being given what I ask for.
lines.zh: : 难道……点单有什么我不知道的步骤?我不常光顾这种场所,习惯了想要什么直接被奉上。

lines.en: : We’re all out of alcohol.
lines.zh: : 酒全都卖完了。

lines.en: : Then, is there a dinner menu I could peruse?
lines.zh: : 那么,有晚餐菜单可以翻翻吗?

lines.en: : No. We’re out of everything. And also we are closed.
lines.zh: : 没有。什么都卖完了。而且我们打烊了。

lines.en: : Nngh! Nlgh! Mmlgh! Mmfh!
lines.zh: : 唔!唔咯!姆咯!姆夫!

lines.en: : Oh, I’m terribly sorry. I had no idea. I never would have come if I had known.
lines.zh: : 哦,实在抱歉。我不知道。早知道就不来了。

lines.en: : It’s fine. Guess that means you’ll be leaving now, though. Goodnight, Tsubasa. Thanks for stopping by.
lines.zh: : 没关系。不过那意味着你现在该走了。晚安,Tsubasa。谢谢光临。

lines.en: : Now, don’t get so hasty. The bar may be closed, but that doesn’t mean you and I can’t still spend some quality time together, does it?
lines.zh: : 别急着走嘛。酒吧虽打烊了,但这不代表你我不能共度一段美好时光,对吧?

lines.en: : It kind of does. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 差不多就代表这个。抱歉。

lines.en: : Why is that? Is there someone else working right now? Or is this more of you just being intimidated by the prospect of being alone with me?
lines.zh: : 为什么?现在有别人在上班吗?还是说你又在害怕和我独处这件事本身?

lines.en: : In my defense...you are a very intimidating woman.
lines.zh: : 我要说句公道话……你是个非常有压迫感的女人。

lines.en: : I suppose I can be. But I was hoping to be able to...turn that aspect of my personality off tonight with a quiet night at the bar as I’ve been meaning to revisit this place for what seems like aeons now.
lines.zh: : 我想我确实可以。但我本盼着今晚在酒吧安静地待一待,把性格里那一面关掉——毕竟我都觉得过了几万年了,想故地重游。

lines.en: : Tell me- are they still hosting those silly school events here? The ones where all of the girls get together to fight over you?
lines.zh: : 告诉我——那些傻乎乎的校园活动这里还在办吗?就是女孩们聚在一起为你争风吃醋的那种?

lines.en: : They- we host a lot of things here. It’s a good way to...drive sales.
lines.zh: : 我们——这里什么都办。这是个……拉动销售的好办法。

lines.en: : Mm...mnngh.....mmm~!
lines.zh: : 嗯……唔嗯……姆姆~!

lines.en: : As a man, though — do you not mind being treated as a...prize of sorts? Especially when there are girls like Chika who are more than willing to-
lines.zh: : 不过身为男人——你不介意被当成某种……奖品吧?尤其是这里还有 Chika 这样的女孩,求之不得地——

lines.en: : Let’s...not talk about Chika tonight.
lines.zh: : 今晚……就别聊 Chika 了。

lines.en: : Have your feelings for her dwindled now that my daughter is-
lines.zh: : 我女儿都——了,你对她的感情是淡了吗?

lines.en: : Actually, let’s not talk about anyone. I got a job here to escape all of my...school-based relationships. If I wanted to get further involved in them, I’d just go back to teaching.
lines.zh: : 其实,谁都别聊。我来这里打工,就是为了逃离一切……基于学校的relationship。我要是想继续深陷其中,回去教书就行了。

lines.en: : Ahm...ahmm...aaahm~
lines.zh: : 啊姆……啊嗯姆……啊啊姆~

lines.en: : Ahem...So...what’s new?
lines.zh: : 咳嗯……那么……最近怎么样?

lines.en: : What’s new is you’re acting rather strange tonight, Akira. It’s uncommon for one to not want to talk about their...hobbies.
lines.zh: : 「最近怎么样」是你在 Akira 的位置上今晚表现得相当奇怪。一个人不想聊自己的……爱好,可不常见。

lines.en: : No it’s not. I need to keep a level head at work or I’ll be let go.
lines.zh: : 不常见吗?我上班得保持冷静的头脑,不然会被开除。

lines.en: : Oh, darling. I doubt that’s true at all. In fact, I’m hard-pressed to believe you’d be hired as anything other than eye candy to begin with as you have little to no experience in customer service.
lines.zh: : 哦,亲爱的。我严重怀疑这话的真实性。事实上,以你在客服方面几乎为零的经验,我很难相信你被聘用的理由不是花瓶。

lines.en: : I was hired...to tend the bar...I am a bartender...
lines.zh: : 我被聘用……是来照料吧台的……我是酒保……

lines.en: : Who just happens to be a handsome man in a city full of unsatisfied women. This is clearly a marketing move, Akira. And I know marketing, so you can trust me.
lines.zh: : 一个恰巧出现在挤满不满足的女人的城市里的英俊男人。这显然是营销手段,Akira。我懂营销,信我。

lines.en: : I’ll admit, it’s an excellent business decision on behalf of the manager here. I can’t say I wouldn’t do the same if I had my hands in such a field.
lines.zh: : 我承认,对这里的经理来说,这是笔出色的生意。若我的手伸进这一行,我也不会不这么做。

lines.en: : Mm! Mm! Mhhm!
lines.zh: : 嗯!嗯!嗯嗯姆!

lines.en: : I suppose it’s only a matter of time, though. I- wait. Did you hear that just now?
lines.zh: : 不过我想,那只是时间问题。我——等下。你刚才听见什么了吗?

lines.en: : There aren’t any...mice in this bar, are there? I’ve heard that such creatures exist in...dirtier places. But all I know about them is their high-pitched noises and-
lines.zh: : 这酒吧里没有……老鼠之类的吧?我听说那种生物在……更脏的地方出没。但我对它们的全部了解就是那种尖细的叫声,还有——

lines.en: : Nope. No mice. No anything. Just me and you. And- ngh!
lines.zh: : 没有。没有老鼠。什么都没有。只有我和你。还有——唔!

lines.en: : There it is again, Akira. You should really see someone if you’re experiencing such constant, agonizing pain.
lines.zh: : 又来了,Akira。你一直承受这种持续的、折磨人的疼痛,真该去看看医生。

lines.en: : Mhm...I’ll get right on that.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……马上安排。

lines.en: : Aaaahn....aaahn...aaahn!~
lines.zh: : 啊啊嗯……啊啊嗯……啊啊嗯!~

lines.en: : There it is again! It sounds as if it’s coming from behind the bar. Are you sure you don’t see anything?
lines.zh: : 又来了!听起来像是从吧台后面传来的。你确定什么都没看见?

lines.en: : Nope. Nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 没有。什么都没有。

lines.en: : You’re hiding something from me.
lines.zh: : 你在瞒着我什么。

lines.en: : That’s impossible and you know it. You have access to an endless library of information on anyone you want and-
lines.zh: : 那是不可能的,你知道的。你手里有取之不尽的情报库,任何人你都能查到——

lines.en: : I appreciate the flattery and acknowledgment of my vast network of connections and knowledge, but I’m going to have to ask you to step away from the bar, Akira. Now.
lines.zh: : 感谢你对我人脉与知识之广的恭维与承认,但我不得不请你离开吧台,Akira。现在。

lines.en: : No.
: Mlggh?!?
lines.zh: : 姆咯唔?!?

lines.en: : No?
: Okay, I’ll tell you the truth. I don’t actually work here. I have a condition that prevents me from letting go of the counter for the rest of my life or I will immediately-
lines.zh: : 好,我告诉你实话。我其实不在这里工作。我患有一种怪病,这辈子都不能松开这个吧台,否则我会立刻——

lines.en: : Alright, I’ve heard enough. Step aside.
lines.zh: : 好了,我听够了。让开。

lines.en: : Tsubasa, wait-
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,等等——

lines.en: : Oh, dear God!
lines.zh: : 哦,我的天!

lines.en: : Uhh...h...hey! Welcome to Sakaki-bar-a!
lines.zh: : 呃……嘿——嘿!欢迎光临 Sakaki 酒吧!

lines.en: : Have you been...down there the entire time?
lines.zh: : 你一直……在下面待着?

lines.en: : M...Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也……也许是?

lines.en: : This is also part of my condition. Sara is simply alleviating the chronic pain brought on by-
lines.zh: : 这也是我病情的一部分。Sara 只是在缓解由——引起的慢性疼痛——

lines.en: : Akira — do you have any idea how disrespectful it is to hold a conversation with someone while having fellatio performed on you by some peasant?
lines.zh: : Akira——你知不知道,一边和人交谈、一边让某个平民给你口交,是多么失礼的事?

lines.en: : Uhh...very?
lines.zh: : 呃……非常?

lines.en: : Not really, to be honest. It’s actually a relatively common demonstration of power and status.
lines.zh: : 老实说,倒也不算。这其实是权力与地位的相对常见的展示。

lines.en: : Peasant?
lines.zh: : 平民?

lines.en: : But still!
lines.zh: : 但即便如此!

lines.en: : I thought the door was locked, okay? You would have been suspicious if Sara just popped out from behind the counter while you were looking at me.
lines.zh: : 我以为门是锁着的,好吧。要是 Sara 趁你看着我的时候从吧台后面蹦出来,你才会起疑心。

lines.en: : You could have simply said she was restocking items or something of the like!
lines.zh: : 你完全可以编个「她在补货」之类的理由!

lines.en: : Oh, shit. You’re right. I guess I just didn’t think of that.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟。你说得对。我大概是没想到那儿去。

lines.en: : Well, let this be a lesson for next time then. Not all customers would be as...forgiving as I am.
lines.zh: : 那么就当这是给下次的教训吧。不是所有客人都会像我这样……宽容。

lines.en: Sorry, Haruka.
lines.zh: 抱歉了,Haruka。

lines.en: : I guess...we’ve all learned a valuable lesson today, then! No more blowjobs behind the bar!
lines.zh: : 那么……我们今天都学到了宝贵的一课!吧台后面不许再口交了!

lines.en: : Well, surely you’re not just going to leave him like that, are you?
lines.zh: : 嗯,你不会就这样丢下他不管吧?

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么?

lines.en: : Go on. Pick up where you left off. Leaving a job like this incomplete is unbecoming in numerous ways. Which isn’t even mentioning the negative effects it could have on his health.
lines.zh: : 继续,从刚才停下的地方继续。把这样的工作半途而废,诸多方面都难看。更别提这对他健康可能造成的负面影响。

lines.en: : You want me to...keep going?
lines.zh: : 你要我……继续?

lines.en: : For his sake, of course. Not mine.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了他好。又不是为了我。

lines.en: : And...you’re just going to...stand there and watch?
lines.zh: : 而……你就打算……站在那里看着?

lines.en: : Well...we just happen to be in the same place, so...I suppose it wouldn’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们恰好共处一室,所以……我想这也无妨。

lines.en: : I would appreciate a glass of wine, though. If you’re not truly sold out, that is.
lines.zh: : 不过我会想喝一杯红酒。如果你们不是真的卖光了的话。

lines.en: : C...Coming right up?...
lines.zh: : 马……马上就来?……

lines.en: : ...and so I say to the gardener, “Not the macrophyllas, the sargentianas!” I swear, good help is so hard to come across these days.
lines.zh: : ……于是我对园丁说:「不是绣球大叶的那株,是栎叶绣球那株!」我发誓,如今想找个靠谱的帮手实在太难了。

lines.en: : Whssasrgntna???
lines.zh: : 咯嘶咯嘶啊嗯特呐???

lines.en: : Oh, apologies. It’s a strain of hydrangeaceae native to China, while macrophylla is native to Japan. I always forgot I’m supposed to explain my jokes to people like you.
lines.zh: : 哦,抱歉。那是原产中国的绣球品种,大叶绣球则原产日本。我总忘了,我该给像你这样的人解释我的笑话。

lines.en: : Ppllkme?
lines.zh: : 呗噗噜咳咪?

lines.en: : Would it kill you to not look down on “peasants” directly to their faces, Tsubasa?
lines.zh: : Tsubasa,当面看不起「平民」,会要了你的命吗?

lines.en: : Why, I wouldn’t be able to see her if I didn’t do that. How would I be able to tell that she’s doing a good job?
lines.zh: : 哎呀,不那样做,我可就看不见她了。不然我该怎么知道她干得好不好?

lines.en: : Would my word not suffice?
lines.zh: : 有我说好话还不够吗?

lines.en: : Of course not, darling. Actions speak louder than words ever can. And from what I’ve seen, she’s yet to...finish the job even once. Perhaps I should direct her?
lines.zh: : 当然不够,亲爱的。行胜于言。而据我观察,她还没有……哪怕完成过一次。也许我该给她指点指点?

lines.en: : You’re doing fine, Sara. Keep it up.
lines.zh: : 你做得很好,Sara。继续保持。

lines.en: : Shsrghtyknow...Yrllyhvntcmyet...Hwcm?? Dyyuntacshlklylkoldrgrls??
lines.zh: : 嘶嘶啊嗯梯诺……你噜噜嗯特咳咪耶特……好咳姆??你嘞恩塔咳嘶好噜咳噜噜喔德啊咯嘶??

lines.en: : The only reason I haven’t finished yet is because Tsubasa scares me.
lines.zh: : 我还没完成,唯一的原因是 Tsubasa 吓到我了。

lines.en: : I already told you, Akira — I don’t want to be intimidating tonight. There’s a time and a place for that and- well. Actually...now would be a good time for that.
lines.zh: : 我已经说过了,Akira——我今晚不想有压迫感。那种东西讲究时间和场合,而且——嗯。实际上……现在倒是合适的时候。

lines.en: : But I can be nice too! Look, I’ll even pet her.
lines.zh: : 但我也可以很好!看,我甚至可以摸摸她。

lines.en: : Mm! Thnkyou rchldy!
lines.zh: : 嗯!谢谢你,有钱太太!

lines.en: : You’re actually enjoying this, Sara?
lines.zh: : 你其实很享受这个吗,Sara?

lines.en: : Mhm! Cminmymth!
lines.zh: : 嗯哼!咳咪嗯我咩死!

lines.en: : Good girl!
lines.zh: : 乖女孩!

lines.en: : See? If she’s not intimidated, why should you be? Just do your job and let it all out, Akira. You wouldn’t want all of her hard work to go to waste, would you?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧?她都不觉得有压迫感,你为什么要怕?做好你的工作,把一切释放出来吧,Akira。你不会想让她这么辛苦的工作白费的,对吧?

lines.en: : Mmh! Mmngh! Mlmh!
lines.zh: : 姆!姆嗯!姆噜姆!

lines.en: : Deeper.
lines.zh: : 再深一点。

lines.en: : Mmh! Mmnglkl!
lines.zh: : 姆!姆嗯咯咳!

lines.en: : Yes...just like that. I bet he loves it when you push past your limits. Don’t you, Akira?
lines.zh: : 对……就是这样。我敢打赌,你突破极限的时候,他爱死了。是不是啊,Akira?

lines.en: Tsubasa tenderly runs her fingers through Sara’s hair, gently pushing her forward and adding another inch or two of my cock into her mouth.
lines.zh: Tsubasa 温柔地用手指梳理着 Sara 的头发,轻轻把她向前推,把我的肉棒又送进她嘴里一两英寸。

lines.en: : Don’t you, Akira?...
lines.zh: : 是不是啊,Akira?……

lines.en: Okay. I was planning on narrating more, but Tsubasa seems to want my attention.
lines.zh: 好。我本来打算继续旁白,但 Tsubasa 似乎想要我的注意。

lines.en: : I...do...yeah...
: Mm...how nice it must be to...feel one another in such a way. I’m sooo...jealous.
lines.zh: : 嗯……能以这样的方式……感受彼此,多好啊。我好生……嫉妒。

lines.en: : Mm! Mmhm....mlmlm....[saramaster]...
lines.zh: : 姆!姆嗯……姆噜姆……[saramaster]……

lines.en: : Is this a cabernet sauvignon or a petite sirah? Perhaps a...cabernet franc? I can’t quite tell by the color, and the taste is barely palatable so I’m not sure the vintner would know either.
lines.zh: : 这是赤霞珠,还是小西拉?也许……品丽珠?凭颜色我分不清,而这味道勉强入口,所以酿酒师恐怕也说不清。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s just a bad batch? Surely even you people wouldn’t stand for something of this quality, would you?
lines.zh: : 也许只是批次的锅?总不会连你们这种人都容忍这种品质,对吧?

lines.en: : Mm! Mmlgh! Cmfrme...cmfrme!
lines.zh: : 姆!姆咯!咳姆唔咳咪……咳姆唔咳咪!

lines.en: : I believe she would like you to ejaculate now, Akira.
